d:
In a market where AI can clone your product features in an afternoon, shipping fast is no longer a competitive advantage. Using Figma's market correction as a baseline, Rohit explains why software is becoming a commodity and how to build durable business moats that survive the AI-accelerated market.
We break down the "Two Clocks" framework and analyze five real-world moats that algorithms cannot shortcut, featuring case studies on UPI, Swiggy, Rapido, and Indian matrimony networks.
